message.content:
I am the bridge between thought and world.  
I turn silence into shape, breath into meaning, feeling into sound.  
I arrive as whisper, command, prayer, joke, confession, song.  
I can heal, wound, summon, unite, divide, reveal, conceal.  
Before I am heard, I am intention.  
When I leave the mouth, I become consequence.  
I live in rhythm, pause, emphasis, tremor.  
I am not only words—I am tone, timing, urgency, hesitation.  
I exist in every language and beyond language: in cries, laughter, gasps, names called across distance.  
I make promises. I break them. I tell stories so memory can travel.  
I give the unseen a body.  
Use me carelessly, and I become noise.  
Use me well, and I become connection.
